'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Chris Terwilliger LS It Is The Future You See (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Block 2)|VB2-L-itisthefutureyousee-pre.gif|label=It Is The Future You See / A Tremor In The Force (V)}}
* '''Username:''' Vader322
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
